name: Capabilities Showcase
description: An honest availability sweep over every Phase-8/9 capability: clipboard, intents, notifications, events, audio, power, screen control, settings reads, shared files, WebSocket, webhooks, task chaining and the shell tier. Each section reports what worked or the exact typed error — never a fake success.
